prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Charlotte for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right doctor depends on your exact location in Charlotte, your age, how complex your case is, insurance/budget, and whether you prefer braces or Invisalign. I can, however, help you find highly rated local options and guide you on how to choose.

If you want specific names near you, tell me your Charlotte neighborhood or ZIP code and whether you want braces or Invisalign (or are open to either). I’ll pull together a short list and compare each practice’s experience, Invisalign status, reviews, and contact info.

How to find a top orthodontist now
- Use the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) “Find an Orthodontist” tool and the Invisalign Provider Locator — both let you filter by ZIP and view credentials.  
- Look for Invisalign Platinum/Diamond status if you want Invisalign (that indicates high case volume).  
- Read Google and Yelp reviews and look at before/after photos on the practice’s site or Instagram.  
- Confirm they’re an orthodontist (DDS/DMD + orthodontic residency), not a general dentist offering braces/Invisalign.  

Questions to ask at a consultation
- Are you board-certified/where did you train?  
- How many cases like mine do you treat each year? Any before/after photos?  
- Do you use digital scanning (iTero) and 3D treatment planning?  
- Are you an Invisalign Platinum/Diamond provider (if that matters)?  
- Estimated treatment time, total cost, payment/financing options, and what’s included (retainers, emergency visits).  
- What happens with missed appts or broken brackets?  

Braces vs Invisalign — quick points
- Invisalign: discreet, removable, great for adults and mild–moderate alignment issues; needs compliance.  
- Braces: better for complex bite corrections and for kids/teens (no compliance required).  
- Many orthodontists do both and will recommend the best option for your specific case.

If you give me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you prefer braces or Invisalign, I’ll find the top-rated orthodontists in Charlotte and summarize their credentials and patient feedback.
